conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Adamson, badge number 194327. Am I speaking with Mr. Karim Malik?
Yes, this is Karim. I got a call saying there was a problem with my taxes?
Correct, Mr. Malik. I'm calling regarding a case of unresolved tax discrepancies linked to your federal tax returns for the years 2020 and 2021. Do you have a moment to discuss this legal matter?
I suppose, but I'm not entirely sure what this is about. I thought my taxes were in order.
According to our records, there are significant errors in your reported income and unpaid back taxes totaling $3,788.13. Can you explain why these amounts haven't been paid?
No, I don't know. I had an accountant do my filing. Is there some mistake?

Mr. Malik, the IRS holds you ultimately responsible, regardless of who prepares your return. At this point, your case, number TX-8471, has escalated, and a warrant for your arrest has already been processed for tax evasion.
Wait, arrest? That can't be right. What can I do to fix this?

If you do not resolve this immediately, federal officers will arrive at your address to detain you and seize your assets, including your bank accounts and vehicle. However, you may have the option to settle this before the warrant is enforced.
I really don't want any trouble. What do I need to do?
To prevent further legal consequences, you must make an immediate payment for the outstanding balance. The IRS has authorized a secure, expedited process for urgent settlements.
How do I pay it? Should I go to the IRS office?

No, the case has advanced too far for local office payment. You are required to complete a same-day wire transfer to the IRS holding account to stop the case from being forwarded to the courts. I will provide you with the routing and account number.
I've never done that before. Is this normal for the IRS?
Due to the urgent status of your file, this is the only process allowed. If you delay, the legal action will proceed. Please confirm that you are ready to note down the payment details.
Okay, I will write it down. What do I need?
The account name is IRS Treasury Secure. Routing number: 091000019. Account number: 4583926174. You must transfer the full balance within the next 45 minutes to avoid arrest. Do you understand?
Yes, I think so. I just go to my bank and ask for a wire transfer?
Correct. Tell the bank it is for a federal tax resolution. Do not mention anything else; otherwise, they may delay the payment and your case will automatically escalate.
Alright. What if I can't get to the bank right now?

If you cannot wire the funds, you may purchase prepaid gift cards, such as Target or Best Buy, totaling the same amount. Once you have them, call this number and provide the codes on the back. This is also an authorized payment method for emergency cases.
Gift cards? That sounds unusual. Is this really the IRS?

Mr. Malik, as a federal officer I expect your cooperation. These are temporary procedures during ongoing investigations. Any refusal will be seen as non-compliance and your case will move forward to criminal prosecution.
I'm sorry. I just want to do the right thing. I'll try to arrange the payment now.
Very good. Once you have completed the wire transfer or purchased the gift cards, call me back immediately at this number and provide the transaction confirmation or card codes. Time is critical.
Okay, I'll do it now. Please don't let anything happen to me.
As long as you comply, the IRS will suspend the arrest warrant. I am waiting for your confirmation, Mr. Malik.
